test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Within the walled palace, rows of attractive food stalls, souvenir bouteques and entertainment platforms have been erected by the prominent delegations.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bouteques"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**boutiques**".
 
 
• **Meaning:** A small shop or store that sells fashionable clothes or accessories. (फैशनेबल कपड़े या सामान बेचने वाली छोटी दुकान)
 
• **Example:** She visited several **boutiques **to find the perfect dress for the party.
 
 
 
• The word **"boutiques"** is the correct spelling.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Erected **(निर्मित): To build or construct something.

 
 
• **Example:** They **erected **a monument in the town square to honour the heroes.
 
 
 
• **Prominent **(प्रमुख): Important or famous; easily noticeable.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist is a **prominent **figure in the field of genetics.
 
 
 
• **Souvenir** (स्मारिका): An item kept as a reminder of a place or event.
 
 
• **Example:** She brought back a small **souvenir **from her trip to Paris.
